system.description:
Old forest, deep shade, and long stretches without a view of the sky. Trails fade within a day and sound carries oddly between the trunks. People learn to move quietly, read tracks, and wait.

Talent: one Finesse die to d12, one Wit die to d8.

  • Marked Prey. You learn the Marked Prey Technique: Ranged, Stress, +1, Pierce 1.
  • Camouflaged Skin. +2 on Stealth rolls.
